root_cause.text: The `apple_smc_probe()` function fails to initialize the `mutex` field of `struct apple_smc`, causing a NULL pointer dereference when sub-devices attempt to acquire the uninitialized lock during `apple_smc_read()` calls.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff adds `mutex_init(&smc->mutex);` to `apple_smc_probe()` in `drivers/mfd/macsmc.c`, and the commit message notes that "Using the mutex uninitialized surprisingly resulted only in occasional NULL pointer dereferences in apple_smc_read() calls from the probe() functions of sub devices."
